method: Independent full static reading of game source, then line-level verification. No runtime or gameplay. Current source only; no historical-version claim.

K1.explanation: Adapter maps ACTION1-4 to cardinal moves and ACTION5 to ACTION; game action rule commits selection.

K2.explanation: Shared collision layer blocks walls/crates; adjacent normalcrate receives movement only from pushing player. No chain-push rule.

evidence.quote: Player, Wall, Crate, possible_crate, selected_crate, normalcrate
[> player no indicator | normalcrate] -> [> player no indicator | > normalcrate]

K3.explanation: Entry replaces crate with player and places marker two cells further; perpendicular neighbor rules generate the two knight landing positions.

evidence.quote: [> player no indicator| Crate | | ] -> [ | player indicator_placing | | > knight_marker]

K4.explanation: Only no-object landing cells receive possible_crate; object includes wall, red/normal crates and player. Without a possible cell indicator_placing persists and cancels move.

evidence.quote: object = Crate or wall or player or normalcrate

K5.explanation: A possible cell becomes selected, movement rules exchange selected/possible along the direction, and player orthogonal movement is stripped during selection.

K6.explanation: ACTION removes other possible cells, converts selected_crate to Crate and clears selecting indicator on player.

K7.explanation: All Target on crates, with crates defined as Crate or normalcrate. Target itself is dark blue.
